WITH "base_transactions" AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', "block_timestamp_month") AS "month",
    "hash",
    "inputs",
    "outputs"
  FROM CRYPTO.CRYPTO_BITCOIN.TRANSACTIONS
  WHERE "block_timestamp_month" >= DATE '2021-01-01'
    AND "block_timestamp_month" < DATE '2022-01-01'
),
"input_totals" AS (
  SELECT
    t."hash" AS "hash",
    COUNT(*) AS "input_count",
    SUM(COALESCE(TRY_TO_NUMBER(i.value:"value"::STRING), 0)) AS "input_value"
  FROM "base_transactions" AS t,
    LATERAL FLATTEN(input => t."inputs") AS i
  GROUP BY t."hash"
),
"output_values" AS (
  SELECT
    t."hash" AS "hash",
    TRY_TO_NUMBER(o.value:"value"::STRING) AS "output_value"
  FROM "base_transactions" AS t,
    LATERAL FLATTEN(input => t."outputs") AS o
),
"output_totals" AS (
  SELECT
    "hash",
    COUNT(*) AS "output_count",
    SUM(COALESCE("output_value", 0)) AS "output_value"
  FROM "output_values"
  GROUP BY "hash"
),
"repeated_equal_output_values" AS (
  SELECT
    "hash",
    "output_value"
  FROM "output_values"
  WHERE "output_value" IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY "hash", "output_value"
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
),
"repeated_equal_output_transactions" AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    "hash"
  FROM "repeated_equal_output_values"
),
"transaction_metrics" AS (
  SELECT
    t."month" AS "month",
    t."hash" AS "hash",
    COALESCE(i."input_count", 0) AS "input_count",
    COALESCE(i."input_value", 0) AS "input_value",
    COALESCE(o."output_count", 0) AS "output_count",
    COALESCE(o."output_value", 0) AS "output_value"
  FROM "base_transactions" AS t
  LEFT JOIN "input_totals" AS i
    ON t."hash" = i."hash"
  LEFT JOIN "output_totals" AS o
    ON t."hash" = o."hash"
),
"coinjoin_transactions" AS (
  SELECT
    tm."month" AS "month",
    tm."hash" AS "hash",
    tm."input_count" AS "input_count",
    tm."input_value" AS "input_value",
    tm."output_count" AS "output_count",
    tm."output_value" AS "output_value"
  FROM "transaction_metrics" AS tm
  INNER JOIN "repeated_equal_output_transactions" AS r
    ON tm."hash" = r."hash"
  WHERE tm."output_count" > 2
    AND tm."output_value" <= tm."input_value"
),
"monthly_totals" AS (
  SELECT
    "month",
    COUNT(*) AS "total_transaction_count",
    SUM("output_value") AS "total_volume",
    SUM("input_count") AS "total_input_count",
    SUM("output_count") AS "total_output_count"
  FROM "transaction_metrics"
  GROUP BY "month"
),
"monthly_coinjoins" AS (
  SELECT
    "month",
    COUNT(*) AS "coinjoin_transaction_count",
    SUM("output_value") AS "coinjoin_volume",
    SUM("input_count") AS "coinjoin_input_count",
    SUM("output_count") AS "coinjoin_output_count"
  FROM "coinjoin_transactions"
  GROUP BY "month"
),
"monthly_percentages" AS (
  SELECT
    MONTH(mt."month") AS "month_number",
    ROUND(COALESCE(mc."coinjoin_transaction_count", 0) / NULLIF(mt."total_transaction_count", 0) * 100, 1) AS "coinjoin_transaction_percentage",
    ROUND((
      COALESCE(mc."coinjoin_input_count", 0) / NULLIF(mt."total_input_count", 0) * 100 +
      COALESCE(mc."coinjoin_output_count", 0) / NULLIF(mt."total_output_count", 0) * 100
    ) / 2, 1) AS "coinjoin_utxo_percentage",
    ROUND(COALESCE(mc."coinjoin_volume", 0) / NULLIF(mt."total_volume", 0) * 100, 1) AS "coinjoin_volume_percentage",
    COALESCE(mc."coinjoin_volume", 0) / NULLIF(mt."total_volume", 0) * 100 AS "coinjoin_volume_percentage_raw"
  FROM "monthly_totals" AS mt
  LEFT JOIN "monthly_coinjoins" AS mc
    ON mt."month" = mc."month"
)
SELECT
  "month_number",
  "coinjoin_transaction_percentage",
  "coinjoin_utxo_percentage",
  "coinjoin_volume_percentage"
FROM "monthly_percentages"
ORDER BY "coinjoin_volume_percentage_raw" DESC NULLS LAST, "month_number" ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH "tx_2021" AS (

    "hash",
    "input_count",
    "output_count",
    "input_value",
    "output_value",
    "inputs",
    "outputs"
  FROM CRYPTO.CRYPTO_BITCOIN.TRANSACTIONS
  WHERE "block_timestamp_month" >= DATE '2021-01-01'
    AND "block_timestamp_month" < DATE '2022-01-01'
),
"input_metrics" AS (
  SELECT
    t."hash",
    COUNT(i.value) AS "input_utxo_count",
    SUM(COALESCE(i.value:"value"::NUMBER, 0)) AS "input_value_flat"
  FROM "tx_2021" t,
    LATERAL FLATTEN(input => t."inputs", OUTER => TRUE) i
  GROUP BY t."hash"
),
"output_value_counts" AS (
  SELECT
    t."hash",
    o.value:"value"::NUMBER AS "output_value_each",
    COUNT(o.value) AS "equal_value_output_count"
  FROM "tx_2021" t,
    LATERAL FLATTEN(input => t."outputs", OUTER => TRUE) o
  GROUP BY
    t."hash",
    o.value:"value"::NUMBER
),
"output_metrics" AS (
  SELECT
    "hash",
    SUM("equal_value_output_count") AS "output_utxo_count",
    SUM(COALESCE("output_value_each", 0) * "equal_value_output_count") AS "output_value_flat",
    MAX("equal_value_output_count") AS "max_equal_value_output_count"
  FROM "output_value_counts"
  GROUP BY "hash"
),
"classified_transactions" AS (
  SELECT
    t."month_start",
    t."hash",
    COALESCE(i."input_utxo_count", t."input_count") AS "input_utxo_count",
    COALESCE(o."output_utxo_count", t."output_count") AS "output_utxo_count",
    COALESCE(o."output_value_flat", t."output_value") AS "transaction_volume",
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(o."output_utxo_count", t."output_count") > 2
        AND t."output_value" <= t."input_value"
        AND COALESCE(o."max_equal_value_output_count", 0) > 1
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS "is_coinjoin"
  FROM "tx_2021" t
  LEFT JOIN "input_metrics" i
    ON t."hash" = i."hash"
  LEFT JOIN "output_metrics" o
    ON t."hash" = o."hash"
),
"monthly_metrics" AS (
  SELECT
    "month_start",
    ROUND(COUNT_IF("is_coinjoin" = 1) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100, 1) AS "coinjoin_transaction_percentage",
    ROUND(
      (
        SUM(IFF("is_coinjoin" = 1, "input_utxo_count", 0)) / NULLIF(SUM("input_utxo_count"), 0) * 100
        +
        SUM(IFF("is_coinjoin" = 1, "output_utxo_count", 0)) / NULLIF(SUM("output_utxo_count"), 0) * 100
      ) / 2,
      1
    ) AS "coinjoin_utxo_percentage",
    ROUND(SUM(IFF("is_coinjoin" = 1, "transaction_volume", 0)) / NULLIF(SUM("transaction_volume"), 0) * 100, 1) AS "coinjoin_volume_percentage"
  FROM "classified_transactions"
  GROUP BY "month_start"
)
SELECT
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "month_start") AS "month_number",
  "coinjoin_transaction_percentage",

WITH "tx_2021" AS (

        "hash",

    WHERE "block_timestamp_month" >= DATE '2021-01-01'
      AND "block_timestamp_month" < DATE '2022-01-01'
),

    SELECT
        t."hash",
        COUNT(*) AS "flattened_input_count",
        SUM(TRY_TO_NUMBER(i.value:"value"::STRING)) AS "flattened_input_value"
    FROM "tx_2021" AS t,
         LATERAL FLATTEN(input => t."inputs") AS i
    GROUP BY t."hash"
),
"output_value_counts" AS (
    SELECT
        t."hash",
        TRY_TO_NUMBER(o.value:"value"::STRING) AS "output_value_each",
        COUNT(*) AS "same_value_output_count"
    FROM "tx_2021" AS t,
         LATERAL FLATTEN(input => t."outputs") AS o
    GROUP BY t."hash", TRY_TO_NUMBER(o.value:"value"::STRING)
),
"output_stats" AS (
    SELECT
        "hash",
        SUM("same_value_output_count") AS "flattened_output_count",
        SUM("output_value_each" * "same_value_output_count") AS "flattened_output_value",
        MAX(IFF("same_value_output_count" >= 2 AND "output_value_each" IS NOT NULL, 1, 0)) AS "has_multiple_equal_value_outputs"
    FROM "output_value_counts"
    GROUP BY "hash"
),

    SELECT
        t."hash",
        t."month",
        COALESCE(t."input_count", i."flattened_input_count", 0) AS "input_utxo_count",
        COALESCE(t."output_count", o."flattened_output_count", 0) AS "output_utxo_count",

        IFF(
            COALESCE(t."output_count", o."flattened_output_count", 0) > 2

            AND COALESCE(o."has_multiple_equal_value_outputs", 0) = 1,
            1,
            0
        ) AS "is_coinjoin"
    FROM "tx_2021" AS t

    LEFT JOIN "output_stats" AS o

    "customer_id",
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', TRY_TO_DATE("txn_date", 'YYYYMMDD'))::DATE AS "month_start",
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN "txn_type" ILIKE '%deposit%' THEN "txn_amount"
        WHEN "txn_type" ILIKE '%withdrawal%' THEN -"txn_amount"
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS "month_end_balance"
  FROM "BANK_SALES_TRADING"."BANK_SALES_TRADING"."CUSTOMER_TRANSACTIONS"
  WHERE "txn_date" >= '20200101'
    AND "txn_date" <= '20201231'
    AND ("txn_type" ILIKE '%deposit%' OR "txn_type" ILIKE '%withdrawal%')
  GROUP BY
    "customer_id",
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', TRY_TO_DATE("txn_date", 'YYYYMMDD'))::DATE
),
"customer_month_balances" AS (
  SELECT
    cm."customer_id",
    cm."month_start",
    COALESCE(mt."month_end_balance", 0) AS "month_end_balance"
  FROM "customer_months" cm
  LEFT JOIN "monthly_transactions" mt
    ON cm."customer_id" = mt."customer_id"
   AND cm."month_start" = mt."month_start"
),
"monthly_metrics" AS (
  SELECT
    "month_start",
    SUM(CASE WHEN "month_end_balance" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "positive_balance_customer_count",
    ROUND(AVG("month_end_balance"), 4) AS "average_month_end_balance"
  FROM "customer_month_balances"
  GROUP BY "month_start"
),
"ranked_months" AS (
  SELECT
    "month_start",
    "positive_balance_customer_count",
    "average_month_end_balance",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "positive_balance_customer_count" DESC NULLS LAST, "month_start" ASC) AS "high_rank",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "positive_balance_customer_count" ASC NULLS LAST, "month_start" ASC) AS "low_rank"
  FROM "monthly_metrics"
),
"selected_months" AS (
  SELECT
    'highest_positive_balance_customer_count' AS "selected_month_type",
    "month_start",
    "positive_balance_customer_count",
    "average_month_end_balance"
  FROM "ranked_months"
  WHERE "high_rank" = 1
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT
    'lowest_positive_balance_customer_count' AS "selected_month_type",
    "month_start",
    "positive_balance_customer_count",
    "average_month_end_balance"
  FROM "ranked_months"
  WHERE "low_rank" = 1
),
"average_difference" AS (
  SELECT
    ROUND(
      MAX(CASE WHEN "high_rank" = 1 THEN "average_month_end_balance" END)
      - MAX(CASE WHEN "low_rank" = 1 THEN "average_month_end_balance" END),
      4
    ) AS "average_month_end_balance_difference"
  FROM "ranked_months"
)
SELECT
  sm."selected_month_type",
  sm."month_start",
  sm."positive_balance_customer_count",
  sm."average_month_end_balance",
  ad."average_month_end_balance_difference"
FROM "selected_months" sm
CROSS JOIN "average_difference" ad
ORDER BY
  CASE sm."selected_month_type"
    WHEN 'highest_positive_balance_customer_count' THEN 1
    WHEN 'lowest_positive_balance_customer_count' THEN 2
    ELSE 3
  END ASC,
  sm."month_start" ASC;

),
customers AS (

),
monthly_customer_transactions AS (

        "customer_id",

        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN LOWER(TRIM("txn_type")) = 'deposit' THEN ABS(COALESCE("txn_amount", 0))
                WHEN LOWER(TRIM("txn_type")) LIKE 'withdr%' THEN -ABS(COALESCE("txn_amount", 0))
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS "month_transaction_balance"
    FROM parsed_transactions
    WHERE "transaction_date" >= TO_DATE('2020-01-01')
      AND "transaction_date" < TO_DATE('2021-01-01')

      )

),

        COALESCE(monthly_customer_transactions."month_transaction_balance", 0) AS "month_end_balance"
    FROM customers
    CROSS JOIN months
    LEFT JOIN monthly_customer_transactions
        ON customers."customer_id" = monthly_customer_transactions."customer_id"
       AND months."month_start" = monthly_customer_transactions."month_start"
),
monthly_metrics AS (
    SELECT

),
ranked_months AS (
    SELECT
        "month_start",
        "positive_balance_customer_count",
        "average_month_end_balance",
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY "positive_balance_customer_count" DESC, "month_start" ASC
        ) AS "highest_rank",
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY "positive_balance_customer_count" ASC, "month_start" ASC
        ) AS "lowest_rank"
    FROM monthly_metrics
),
selected_months AS (
    SELECT
        'highest_positive_count_month' AS "selected_month_type",
        "month_start",
        "positive_balance_customer_count",
        "average_month_end_balance"

    WHERE "highest_rank" = 1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'lowest_positive_count_month' AS "selected_month_type",
        "month_start",
        "positive_balance_customer_count",
        "average_month_end_balance"
    FROM ranked_months
    WHERE "lowest_rank" = 1
),
average_difference AS (

        MAX(CASE WHEN "selected_month_type" = 'highest_positive_count_month' THEN "average_month_end_balance" END)
        - MAX(CASE WHEN "selected_month_type" = 'lowest_positive_count_month' THEN "average_month_end_balance" END) AS "average_month_end_balance_difference"

),

    FROM "customers"
    CROSS JOIN "months"
    LEFT JOIN "monthly_customer_transactions"

),

    FROM "monthly_metrics"
),
"highest_month" AS (

        "positive_balance_customer_count",

"lowest_month" AS (

    "highest_month"."average_month_end_balance" AS "highest_month_average_month_end_balance",
    "lowest_month"."month_start" AS "lowest_positive_balance_count_month",
    "lowest_month"."positive_balance_customer_count" AS "lowest_positive_balance_customer_count",
    "lowest_month"."average_month_end_balance" AS "lowest_month_average_month_end_balance",
    "highest_month"."average_month_end_balance" - "lowest_month"."average_month_end_balance" AS "average_month_end_balance_difference"

WITH "months" AS (
    SELECT DATEADD(MONTH, "seq", DATE '2020-01-01') AS "month_start"
    FROM (
        SELECT SEQ4() AS "seq"
        FROM TABLE(GENERATOR(ROWCOUNT => 12))
    )
),
"customers" AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        "customer_id"
    FROM BANK_SALES_TRADING.BANK_SALES_TRADING.CUSTOMER_TRANSACTIONS
),
"transactions_2020" AS (
    SELECT
        "customer_id",
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', COALESCE(TRY_TO_DATE("txn_date", 'YYYYMMDD'), TRY_TO_DATE("txn_date", 'YYYY-MM-DD')))::DATE AS "month_start",
        CASE
            WHEN LOWER("txn_type") = 'deposit' THEN "txn_amount"
            WHEN LOWER("txn_type") IN ('withdrawal', 'withdraw') THEN -"txn_amount"
            ELSE 0
        END AS "signed_amount"
    FROM BANK_SALES_TRADING.BANK_SALES_TRADING.CUSTOMER_TRANSACTIONS
    WHERE COALESCE(TRY_TO_DATE("txn_date", 'YYYYMMDD'), TRY_TO_DATE("txn_date", 'YYYY-MM-DD')) >= DATE '2020-01-01'
      AND COALESCE(TRY_TO_DATE("txn_date", 'YYYYMMDD'), TRY_TO_DATE("txn_date", 'YYYY-MM-DD')) < DATE '2021-01-01'
      AND LOWER("txn_type") IN ('deposit', 'withdrawal', 'withdraw')
),
"monthly_transactions" AS (
    SELECT
        "customer_id",
        "month_start",
        SUM("signed_amount") AS "month_end_balance"
    FROM "transactions_2020"
    GROUP BY
        "customer_id",
        "month_start"
),
"customer_month_balances" AS (
    SELECT
        "customers"."customer_id",
        "months"."month_start",
        COALESCE("monthly_transactions"."month_end_balance", 0) AS "month_end_balance"
    FROM "customers"
    CROSS JOIN "months"
    LEFT JOIN "monthly_transactions"
        ON "customers"."customer_id" = "monthly_transactions"."customer_id"
       AND "months"."month_start" = "monthly_transactions"."month_start"
),
"monthly_stats" AS (
    SELECT
        "month_start",
        COUNT_IF("month_end_balance" > 0) AS "positive_balance_customer_count",
        AVG("month_end_balance") AS "average_month_end_balance"
    FROM "customer_month_balances"
    GROUP BY
        "month_start"
),
"ranked_months" AS (
    SELECT
        "month_start",
        "positive_balance_customer_count",
        "average_month_end_balance",
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "positive_balance_customer_count" DESC, "month_start" ASC) AS "highest_rank",
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "positive_balance_customer_count" ASC, "month_start" ASC) AS "lowest_rank"
    FROM "monthly_stats"
)
SELECT
    "highest"."month_start" AS "highest_count_month",
    "highest"."positive_balance_customer_count" AS "highest_positive_balance_customer_count",
    ROUND("highest"."average_month_end_balance", 4) AS "highest_month_average_month_end_balance",
    "lowest"."month_start" AS "lowest_count_month",
    "lowest"."positive_balance_customer_count" AS "lowest_positive_balance_customer_count",
    ROUND("lowest"."average_month_end_balance", 4) AS "lowest_month_average_month_end_balance",
    ROUND("highest"."average_month_end_balance" - "lowest"."average_month_end_balance", 4) AS "average_month_end_balance_difference"
FROM "ranked_months" AS "highest"
CROSS JOIN "ranked_months" AS "lowest"
WHERE "highest"."highest_rank" = 1
  AND "lowest"."lowest_rank" = 1;

WITH "months_2020" AS (
    SELECT TO_DATE("month_value") AS "month_start"
    FROM VALUES
        ('2020-01-01'),
        ('2020-02-01'),
        ('2020-03-01'),
        ('2020-04-01'),
        ('2020-05-01'),
        ('2020-06-01'),
        ('2020-07-01'),
        ('2020-08-01'),
        ('2020-09-01'),
        ('2020-10-01'),
        ('2020-11-01'),
        ('2020-12-01')
        AS "v"("month_value")
),
"customers" AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        "customer_id"
    FROM BANK_SALES_TRADING.BANK_SALES_TRADING.CUSTOMER_TRANSACTIONS
),
"parsed_transactions" AS (
    SELECT
        "customer_id",
        COALESCE(TRY_TO_DATE("txn_date", 'YYYYMMDD'), TRY_TO_DATE("txn_date", 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS "transaction_date",
        CASE
            WHEN LOWER(TRIM("txn_type")) = 'deposit' THEN COALESCE("txn_amount", 0)
            WHEN LOWER(TRIM("txn_type")) IN ('withdrawal', 'withdraw') THEN -COALESCE("txn_amount", 0)
            ELSE 0
        END AS "balance_delta"
    FROM BANK_SALES_TRADING.BANK_SALES_TRADING.CUSTOMER_TRANSACTIONS
    WHERE LOWER(TRIM("txn_type")) IN ('deposit', 'withdrawal', 'withdraw')
),

    SELECT
        "customer_id",
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', "transaction_date") AS "month_start",
        "balance_delta"
    FROM "parsed_transactions"
    WHERE "transaction_date" >= DATE '2020-01-01'
      AND "transaction_date" < DATE '2021-01-01'
),
"customer_months" AS (
    SELECT
        "customers"."customer_id",
        "months_2020"."month_start"
    FROM "customers"
    CROSS JOIN "months_2020"
),
"monthly_customer_balances" AS (
    SELECT
        "customer_months"."customer_id",
        "customer_months"."month_start",
        COALESCE(SUM("transactions_2020"."balance_delta"), 0) AS "month_end_balance"
    FROM "customer_months"
    LEFT JOIN "transactions_2020"
        ON "customer_months"."customer_id" = "transactions_2020"."customer_id"
       AND "customer_months"."month_start" = "transactions_2020"."month_start"
    GROUP BY
        "customer_months"."customer_id",
        "customer_months"."month_start"
),
"monthly_summary" AS (
    SELECT
        "month_start",
        SUM(CASE WHEN "month_end_balance" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "positive_balance_customer_count",
        AVG("month_end_balance") AS "average_month_end_balance"
    FROM "monthly_customer_balances"
    GROUP BY "month_start"
),
"ranked_months" AS (
    SELECT
        "month_start",
        "positive_balance_customer_count",
        "average_month_end_balance",
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "positive_balance_customer_count" DESC, "month_start" ASC) AS "highest_rank",
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "positive_balance_customer_count" ASC, "month_start" ASC) AS "lowest_rank"
    FROM "monthly_summary"
)
SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN "highest_rank" = 1 THEN "month_start" END) AS "highest_count_month",
    MAX(CASE WHEN "highest_rank" = 1 THEN "positive_balance_customer_count" END) AS "highest_positive_balance_customer_count",
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN "highest_rank" = 1 THEN "average_month_end_balance" END), 4) AS "highest_count_month_average_month_end_balance",
    MAX(CASE WHEN "lowest_rank" = 1 THEN "month_start" END) AS "lowest_count_month",
    MAX(CASE WHEN "lowest_rank" = 1 THEN "positive_balance_customer_count" END) AS "lowest_positive_balance_customer_count",
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN "lowest_rank" = 1 THEN "average_month_end_balance" END), 4) AS "lowest_count_month_average_month_end_balance",
    ROUND(
        MAX(CASE WHEN "highest_rank" = 1 THEN "average_month_end_balance" END)
        - MAX(CASE WHEN "lowest_rank" = 1 THEN "average_month_end_balance" END),
        4
    ) AS "difference_between_average_month_end_balances"
FROM "ranked_months";

        "boroname",

),

    GROUP BY

        bs."amount_sold" AS "amount_sold"
    FROM "base_sales" bs
    JOIN "qualifying_cities" qc
        ON bs."cust_city" = qc."cust_city"
       AND bs."cust_state_province" = qc."cust_state_province"
),
"product_overall_sales" AS (
    SELECT
        qs."prod_id" AS "prod_id",
        qs."prod_name" AS "prod_name",
        SUM(qs."amount_sold") AS "overall_sales"
    FROM "qualifying_sales" qs
    GROUP BY

        qs."prod_name"

"ranked_products" AS (
    SELECT
        pos."prod_id" AS "prod_id",
        pos."prod_name" AS "prod_name",
        pos."overall_sales" AS "overall_sales",
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pos."overall_sales" DESC NULLS LAST) AS "product_rank",
        COUNT(*) OVER () AS "product_count"
    FROM "product_overall_sales" pos
),
"top_products" AS (
    SELECT
        rp."prod_id" AS "prod_id",
        rp."prod_name" AS "prod_name"
    FROM "ranked_products" rp
    WHERE rp."product_rank" <= CEIL(rp."product_count" * 0.20)
),
"quarter_totals" AS (
    SELECT
        qs."quarter_start" AS "quarter_start",
        SUM(qs."amount_sold") AS "quarter_total_sales"
    FROM "qualifying_sales" qs
    GROUP BY
        qs."quarter_start"
),
"product_quarter_sales" AS (
    SELECT
        qs."prod_id" AS "prod_id",
        qs."prod_name" AS "prod_name",
        qs."quarter_start" AS "quarter_start",
        SUM(qs."amount_sold") AS "product_quarter_sales"
    FROM "qualifying_sales" qs
    JOIN "top_products" tp
        ON qs."prod_id" = tp."prod_id"
    GROUP BY
        qs."prod_id",
        qs."prod_name",
        qs."quarter_start"
),
"product_shares" AS (
    SELECT
        tp."prod_id" AS "prod_id",
        tp."prod_name" AS "prod_name",
        qt."quarter_start" AS "quarter_start",
        COALESCE(pqs."product_quarter_sales", 0) / NULLIF(qt."quarter_total_sales", 0) AS "sales_share"
    FROM "top_products" tp
    CROSS JOIN "quarter_totals" qt
    LEFT JOIN "product_quarter_sales" pqs
        ON tp."prod_id" = pqs."prod_id"
       AND qt."quarter_start" = pqs."quarter_start"
)
SELECT
    ps."prod_id" AS "prod_id",
    ps."prod_name" AS "prod_name",
    SUM(IFF(ps."quarter_start" = TO_DATE('2019-10-01'), ps."sales_share", 0)) AS "q4_2019_sales_share",
    SUM(IFF(ps."quarter_start" = TO_DATE('2020-10-01'), ps."sales_share", 0)) AS "q4_2020_sales_share",
    SUM(IFF(ps."quarter_start" = TO_DATE('2020-10-01'), ps."sales_share", 0))
        - SUM(IFF(ps."quarter_start" = TO_DATE('2019-10-01'), ps."sales_share", 0)) AS "share_change"
FROM "product_shares" ps
GROUP BY
    ps."prod_id",
    ps."prod_name"
ORDER BY
    "share_change" DESC NULLS LAST,
    "prod_id" ASC;

    HAVING SUM(IFF(cqs."quarter_start" = TO_DATE('2019-10-01'), cqs."city_quarter_sales", 0)) > 0
       AND SUM(IFF(cqs."quarter_start" = TO_DATE('2020-10-01'), cqs."city_quarter_sales", 0))
           >= 1.2 * SUM(IFF(cqs."quarter_start" = TO_DATE('2019-10-01'), cqs."city_quarter_sales", 0))
),
"qualifying_sales" AS (
    SELECT
        bs."prod_id" AS "prod_id",
        bs."prod_name" AS "prod_name",
        bs."quarter_start" AS "quarter_start",

    FROM "base_sales" bs
    JOIN "qualifying_cities" qc
        ON bs."cust_city" = qc."cust_city"

),
"product_overall_sales" AS (
    SELECT
        qs."prod_id" AS "prod_id",
        qs."prod_name" AS "prod_name",

    FROM "qualifying_sales" qs
    GROUP BY
        qs."prod_id",
        qs."prod_name"
),
"ranked_products" AS (
    SELECT
        pos."prod_id" AS "prod_id",
        pos."prod_name" AS "prod_name",
        pos."overall_sales" AS "overall_sales",
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pos."overall_sales" DESC NULLS LAST) AS "product_rank",
        COUNT(*) OVER () AS "product_count"
    FROM "product_overall_sales" pos
),
"top_products" AS (
    SELECT
        rp."prod_id" AS "prod_id",
        rp."prod_name" AS "prod_name"
    FROM "ranked_products" rp
    WHERE rp."product_rank" <= CEIL(rp."product_count" * 0.20)
),
"quarter_totals" AS (
    SELECT
        qs."quarter_start" AS "quarter_start",
        SUM(qs."amount_sold") AS "quarter_total_sales"
    FROM "qualifying_sales" qs
    GROUP BY
        qs."quarter_start"
),
"product_quarter_sales" AS (
    SELECT
        qs."prod_id" AS "prod_id",
        qs."prod_name" AS "prod_name",
        qs."quarter_start" AS "quarter_start",
        SUM(qs."amount_sold") AS "product_quarter_sales"
    FROM "qualifying_sales" qs
    JOIN "top_products" tp
        ON qs."prod_id" = tp."prod_id"
    GROUP BY
        qs."prod_id",
        qs."prod_name",
        qs."quarter_start"
),
"product_shares" AS (
    SELECT
        tp."prod_id" AS "prod_id",
        tp."prod_name" AS "prod_name",
        qt."quarter_start" AS "quarter_start",
        COALESCE(pqs."product_quarter_sales", 0) / NULLIF(qt."quarter_total_sales", 0) AS "sales_share"
    FROM "top_products" tp
    CROSS JOIN "quarter_totals" qt
    LEFT JOIN "product_quarter_sales" pqs
        ON tp."prod_id" = pqs."prod_id"
       AND qt."quarter_start" = pqs."quarter_start"
)
SELECT
    ps."prod_id" AS "prod_id",
    ps."prod_name" AS "prod_name",
    SUM(IFF(ps."quarter_start" = TO_DATE('2019-10-01'), ps."sales_share", 0)) AS "q4_2019_sales_share",
    SUM(IFF(ps."quarter_start" = TO_DATE('2020-10-01'), ps."sales_share", 0)) AS "q4_2020_sales_share",
    SUM(IFF(ps."quarter_start" = TO_DATE('2020-10-01'), ps."sales_share", 0))
        - SUM(IFF(ps."quarter_start" = TO_DATE('2019-10-01'), ps."sales_share", 0)) AS "share_change"
FROM "product_shares" ps
GROUP BY
    ps."prod_id",
    ps."prod_name"
ORDER BY
    "share_change" DESC NULLS LAST,
    "prod_id" ASC;

        tps."q4_2020_product_sales" / NULLIF(qt."q4_2020_total_sales", 0) AS "q4_2020_sales_share"

    GROUP BY "quarter_start"
),
"product_quarter_sales" AS (
    SELECT
        "q"."prod_id" AS "prod_id",
        "q"."quarter_start" AS "quarter_start",
        SUM("q"."sales") AS "product_quarter_sales"
    FROM "qualified_sales" AS "q"
    JOIN "top_products" AS "t"
        ON "t"."prod_id" = "q"."prod_id"
    GROUP BY
        "q"."prod_id",
        "q"."quarter_start"
),
"final_shares" AS (
    SELECT
        "t"."prod_id" AS "prod_id",
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "p"."quarter_start" = TO_DATE('2019-10-01') THEN "p"."product_quarter_sales" / NULLIF("qt"."quarter_total_sales", 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "q4_2019_sales_share",
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "p"."quarter_start" = TO_DATE('2020-10-01') THEN "p"."product_quarter_sales" / NULLIF("qt"."quarter_total_sales", 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "q4_2020_sales_share"
    FROM "top_products" AS "t"
    LEFT JOIN "product_quarter_sales" AS "p"
        ON "p"."prod_id" = "t"."prod_id"
    LEFT JOIN "quarter_totals" AS "qt"
        ON "qt"."quarter_start" = "p"."quarter_start"
    GROUP BY "t"."prod_id"
)
SELECT
    "f"."prod_id" AS "prod_id",
    "p"."prod_name" AS "prod_name",
    ROUND("f"."q4_2019_sales_share", 4) AS "q4_2019_sales_share",
    ROUND("f"."q4_2020_sales_share", 4) AS "q4_2020_sales_share",
    ROUND("f"."q4_2020_sales_share" - "f"."q4_2019_sales_share", 4) AS "share_change"
FROM "final_shares" AS "f"
LEFT JOIN "products_one_row" AS "p"
    ON "p"."prod_id" = "f"."prod_id"
ORDER BY
    "share_change" DESC NULLS LAST,
    "prod_id" ASC;

"top_products" AS (

"product_shares" AS (
    SELECT
        "tp"."prod_id" AS "prod_id",
        "pn"."prod_name" AS "prod_name",
        "qt"."quarter_start" AS "quarter_start",

    CROSS JOIN "quarter_totals" AS "qt"
    LEFT JOIN "product_quarter_sales" AS "pqs"
        ON "pqs"."prod_id" = "tp"."prod_id"
        AND "pqs"."quarter_start" = "qt"."quarter_start"

SELECT

    "prod_name",
    ROUND(COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN "quarter_start" = DATE '2019-10-01' THEN "sales_share" END), 0), 4) AS "q4_2019_sales_share",

        - COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN "quarter_start" = DATE '2019-10-01' THEN "sales_share" END), 0),

"customer_candidates" AS (

    SELECT

    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (

"no_promotion_ids" AS (

    FROM COMPLEX_ORACLE.COMPLEX_ORACLE.PROMOTIONS p

       OR UPPER(COALESCE(p."promo_category", '')) LIKE '%NO%PROMO%'
       OR UPPER(COALESCE(p."promo_subcategory", '')) LIKE '%NO%PROMO%'
       OR UPPER(COALESCE(p."promo_total", '')) LIKE '%NO%PROMO%'
),
"product_keys" AS (
    SELECT
        pr."prod_id" AS "prod_id",
        pr."prod_name" AS "prod_name"
    FROM COMPLEX_ORACLE.COMPLEX_ORACLE.PRODUCTS pr
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY pr."prod_id"
        ORDER BY COALESCE(pr."prod_eff_to", '99999999') DESC, COALESCE(pr."prod_eff_from", '00000000') DESC
    ) = 1
),
"base_sales" AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', TO_DATE(s."time_id", 'YYYYMMDD')) AS "quarter_start",
        COALESCE(TO_VARCHAR(ck."cust_city_id"), UPPER(TRIM(ck."cust_state_province")) || '|' || UPPER(TRIM(ck."cust_city"))) AS "city_key",
        s."prod_id" AS "prod_id",
        s."amount_sold" AS "sales_amount"
    FROM COMPLEX_ORACLE.COMPLEX_ORACLE.SALES s
    JOIN "customer_keys" ck
        ON ck."cust_id" = s."cust_id"
    WHERE (
            s."time_id" BETWEEN '20191001' AND '20191231'
            OR s."time_id" BETWEEN '20201001' AND '20201231'
          )
      AND (
            s."promo_id" IS NULL
            OR s."promo_id" IN (0, 999)
            OR EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM "no_promotion_ids" npi
                WHERE npi."promo_id" = s."promo_id"
            )
          )
),
"city_quarter_sales" AS (
    SELECT
        "city_key",
        SUM(CASE WHEN "quarter_start" = DATE '2019-10-01' THEN "sales_amount" ELSE 0 END) AS "q4_2019_city_sales",
        SUM(CASE WHEN "quarter_start" = DATE '2020-10-01' THEN "sales_amount" ELSE 0 END) AS "q4_2020_city_sales"
    FROM "base_sales"
    GROUP BY "city_key"
),
"qualifying_cities" AS (
    SELECT
        "city_key"
    FROM "city_quarter_sales"
    WHERE "q4_2019_city_sales" > 0
      AND "q4_2020_city_sales" >= "q4_2019_city_sales" * 1.20
),
"qualified_sales" AS (
    SELECT
        bs."quarter_start",
        bs."prod_id",
        bs."sales_amount"
    FROM "base_sales" bs
    JOIN "qualifying_cities" qc
        ON qc."city_key" = bs."city_key"
),
"product_overall_sales" AS (
    SELECT
        "prod_id",
        SUM("sales_amount") AS "overall_sales"
    FROM "qualified_sales"
    GROUP BY "prod_id"
),
"ranked_products" AS (
    SELECT
        "prod_id",
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "overall_sales" DESC) AS "product_rank",
        COUNT(*) OVER () AS "product_count"
    FROM "product_overall_sales"
),
"top_products" AS (
    SELECT
        "prod_id"
    FROM "ranked_products"
    WHERE "product_rank" <= CEIL("product_count" * 0.20)
),
"quarter_totals" AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN "quarter_start" = DATE '2019-10-01' THEN "sales_amount" ELSE 0 END) AS "q4_2019_total_sales",
        SUM(CASE WHEN "quarter_start" = DATE '2020-10-01' THEN "sales_amount" ELSE 0 END) AS "q4_2020_total_sales"
    FROM "qualified_sales"
),
"product_quarter_sales" AS (
    SELECT
        qs."prod_id",
        SUM(CASE WHEN qs."quarter_start" = DATE '2019-10-01' THEN qs."sales_amount" ELSE 0 END) AS "q4_2019_product_sales",
        SUM(CASE WHEN qs."quarter_start" = DATE '2020-10-01' THEN qs."sales_amount" ELSE 0 END) AS "q4_2020_product_sales"
    FROM "qualified_sales" qs
    JOIN "top_products" tp
        ON tp."prod_id" = qs."prod_id"
    GROUP BY qs."prod_id"
)
SELECT
    pqs."prod_id",
    pk."prod_name",
    pqs."q4_2019_product_sales" / NULLIF(qt."q4_2019_total_sales", 0) AS "q4_2019_sales_share",
    pqs."q4_2020_product_sales" / NULLIF(qt."q4_2020_total_sales", 0) AS "q4_2020_sales_share",
    pqs."q4_2020_product_sales" / NULLIF(qt."q4_2020_total_sales", 0)
        - pqs."q4_2019_product_sales" / NULLIF(qt."q4_2019_total_sales", 0) AS "share_change"
FROM "product_quarter_sales" pqs
JOIN "product_keys" pk
    ON pk."prod_id" = pqs."prod_id"
CROSS JOIN "quarter_totals" qt
ORDER BY
    "share_change" DESC NULLS LAST,
    pqs."prod_id" ASC;
